changes.oldText: Paused: Shows deployments that are not terminated but have Desired Replicas set to 0. They move back to Serving once Desired Replicas is 1 or more.
changes.newText: Paused: Shows deployments that are not terminated but have Desired Replicas at 0, so they serve no requests. The Lifecycle column shows whether you set Desired Replicas to 0 or an auto-scaling rule scaled the deployment down. They move back to Serving once Desired Replicas is 1 or more.

changes.oldText: Desired Replicas: The number of replicas to keep running for this deployment. The system scales the active pool toward this target.
changes.newText: Desired Replicas: The number of replicas you set for this deployment. Auto-scaling rules can change the running target without changing this value, and setting it to 0 pauses the deployment.
